display_title: In This Life, You Are a Dog
description:
*“The hunt is over, so the hound must die.”*

Belita, who became the consort of Emperor Kairos of Canavan to protect the Kingdom of Gores, loses everything—her husband, her child, her country—and is killed. But when she opens her eyes again, she finds herself back seven years in the past, and vows revenge against Emperor Kairos and Empress Drusilla, the root of all her suffering...

She finds herself in danger of being exposed as a rebel by the Empire's deposed Crown Prince, Aaron! 

 *‘Can I make Aaron my first hunting dog?’*

Will Belita succeed in taming Aaron and achieving her revenge? A perilous romance between Imperial forces and rebels!

(Source: Naver, translated)
